reference: He asked me whether I had ever pulled a pomegranate open before.
sk: Spýtal sa ma, či som už niekedy otváral granátové jablko.
cz: Zeptal se mě, jestli jsem už někdy otvíral granátové jablko.
acceptable: He asked me {whether|if} I had ever {pulled a pomegranate open|pulled open a pomegranate|opened a pomegranate} {before|}.
He asked {whether|if} I had ever {pulled a pomegranate open|pulled open a pomegranate|opened a pomegranate} {before|}.

mistakes.text: He asked me {whether|if} I have ever {opened|pulled open} a pomegranate before.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po minulom „asked“ sa čas posúva: Present Perfect sa mení na Past Perfect „had ever opened“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po minulém „asked“ se čas posouvá: Present Perfect se mění na Past Perfect „had ever opened“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After past “asked”, the tense moves back: Present Perfect becomes Past Perfect, “had ever opened”.

mistakes.text: He asked me {whether|if} had I ever {opened|pulled open} a pomegranate before.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V nepriamej otázke nie je inverzia: „if I had ever opened“, nie „if had I“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V nepřímé otázce není inverze: „if I had ever opened“, ne „if had I“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Reported questions use statement word order: “if I had ever opened”, not “if had I”.

mistakes.text: He asked me did I ever open a pomegranate before.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Reported speech nepoužíva „did“ ani priamu otázku: „asked me if I had ever opened“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Reported speech nepoužívá „did“ ani přímou otázku: „asked me if I had ever opened“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Reported questions don't use “did”: say “asked me if I had ever opened”.

mistakes.text: He asked me that I had ever {opened|pulled open} a pomegranate before.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri otázke typu áno/nie patrí „if“ alebo „whether“, nie „that“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U otázky typu ano/ne patří „if“ nebo „whether“, ne „that“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A reported yes/no question needs “if” or “whether”, not “that”.

mistakes.text: He asked me {whether|if} I ever {opened|pulled open} a pomegranate before.
mistakes.kind: Past Simple instead of Past Perfect
mistakes.feedback_sk: Skúsenosť pred momentom otázky vyjadruje Past Perfect: „had ever opened“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Zkušenost před okamžikem otázky vyjadřuje Past Perfect: „had ever opened“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Experience before the moment of asking is best in the Past Perfect: “had ever opened”.

source_issues: Slovak and Czech say 'opened' (otváral/otvíral), not specifically 'pulled open'; 'opened' is accepted.
